data.narrative:
Trilobio is a seed-stage biotech company founded by Roya Amini-Naieni and Maximilian Schommer that has raised $11M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 3 public biotech & health peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals, though none provide sufficient comparable datapoints at the same stage and tier.

Only one valuation method proved applicable: stage-progression analysis. Using the $11M total raised as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $28M. This reflects the observed step-up magnitude in biotech financing progression. Peer-median triangulation could not be deployed due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the biotech sector; while public peers exist, target revenue is not disclosed, precluding P/S multiple application.

The single-method analysis supports a valuation range of $23M to $32M, with a median point of $28M. The narrow range derives from the stage-progression method's inputs rather than cross-method consensus. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct peer benchmarking at seed stage, undisclosed revenue metrics, and early-stage financing volatility. A more robust triangulation would require either comparable seed-stage biotech transactions or forward revenue guidance from the target.
